gpsdev.description: Serial I/O device path for GPS communication (overrides GPSDEV environment variable, but overridden by -p command-line option).

datum.description: Geodetic datum code used for coordinate transformations (e.g., WGS84, NAD27); set interactively with -s and stored in ~/.gpstrans.

format.description: Output/input format for data transfer; 'garmin' (native) or 'mxmap' (for Mayko mXmap compatibility); affects -dx/-ux and -m options.

tzoffset.description: Time zone offset in minutes east of UTC (positive for east, negative for west); used for GPS time-to-local conversions.

actions.description: List of data transfer operations to perform. Each entry specifies type, file, and mode. Supported types: 'r' (route), 'w' (waypoint), 't' (track), 'a' (almanac). Mode: 'upload' (via -ux) or 'download' (via -dx). The -m option may be inferred from format='mxmap'.
